name: smwmusic-rapina-bros-reach-to-the-top
title: Rapina Bros. - Reach to the Top
description:
Probably best known as the invincibility theme from Sonic The Next Level, which is a hack of Sonic 1 with a lot of polish, including CD-quality music. This port is just a 30-second section of the song, just like the Sonic The Next Level version.

This song is probably best suited for happy and hopeful areas, like bonus rooms or overworlds, or maybe a sky.

You can probably use this as an invincibility theme as well, but you'll most likely have to lower the echo delay to avoid a pause, as well as add @21 as a global sample. It also lasts much longer than the vanilla star duration.
(Edit: added an additional version that uses a @0 kick.)
